newsitem.title: PERU: SOCCER-UNIVERSITARIO PLAYERS, COACH BANNED AFTER BRAWL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNIVERSITARIO PLAYERS, COACH BANNED AFTER BRAWL.

text.p: Universitario soccer players have been handed bans of between two and four months for their part in a brawl at the end of a Peruvian league match at the weekend.
Universitario's Roberto Martinez was banned for 120 days, while Jose Carranza and Paolo Maldonado, both Peruvian internationals, were banned for 60 and 90 days respectively.
Universitario's Argentine coach Eduardo Lujan was banned from the touchline for six matches and will have to watch his team from the stands, a Peruvian soccer federation official said on Wednesday.
Players and directors from Universitario attacked the referee as tempers flared at the end of Sunday's 1-1 draw with rivals Sporting Cristal.
Pedro Galay of Sporting was also banned for three matches and his team mate Norberto Solano for one.
Both teams had their point from the game deducted.
